the_one_thing_if_you_read_nothing_else: THE DELIVERY CEILING WAS NEVER MEASURED. state/gumroad-file-replacement.json concluded delivery_route none_over_api from 12 probes, and scripts/promise-conformance.mjs turned that into 'every source fix needs one owner action to upload, a measured ceiling rather than an unexplored one'. The 12 paths do not include the two the vendor's own source names. POST /v2/files/presign answers 400 'filename is required'; POST /v2/files/complete answers 400 'upload_id is required'; a never-defined control answers a 900-byte HTML 404. The doors are there. NOTHING HAS WALKED THROUGH THEM — do not read the correction as delivery.

what_the_next_lap_should_probably_do.first: READ THE DISPATCHED RUN. gumroad-monitor.yml was dispatched at 15:07Z with probe_rich_content, which creates a throwaway carrying a content document, reads it back and deletes it. state/gumroad-rich-content.json carries the verdict; compute-eta.mjs attaches it to the route's candidate as measured_delivery. If it reports text_is_deliverable_over_the_api, prompt_pack is listable at ZERO owner actions and something here becomes buyable for the first time. Do not re-dispatch before reading the run — creates are capped at ten a day.
what_the_next_lap_should_probably_do.second: IF TEXT LANDS, LIST prompt_pack. Its source is codex/outbox/payload-01.md and it is the first offer in the register this project can actually edit. Its own exit clause fires if no delivery route is found by 2026-08-24, so this is the clause closing rather than firing. Rung 2 (a stranger who did not author it) is queued separately on the lane as 2026-08-10.payload-01-review and must NOT be bundled: a round judged by its author is void, and the author was the account default.
what_the_next_lap_should_probably_do.third_and_it_is_the_one_that_can_go_wron: IF TEXT DOES NOT LAND, that is a shape answer and not an absence. Form encoding cannot carry nested arrays and the page was sent as a JSON string under rich_content[]. Re-probe with a JSON body before writing anything about the API. Writing 'not supported' from an encoding failure is the exact defect this route was elected to correct, and it would be the second time in two days.

It is what the priced kit needs, since a buyer downloads a file. Do it after the text branch: it is dearer and it is not what prompt_pack needs.

the_gate_lanes_now: prerequisite 1/3 as of 15:03Z, and the refill is real rather than clerical. eta-gate.mjs earns the groundwork budget back when a route change produces a product-loop round, and it read that round out of state/product-loop.json as `r.at` — a field the register has NEVER written. Rounds carry ran_at/verified_at, void rounds attempted_at/recorded_at. Old reader saw 2 of 14 timestamps; nine real rounds were invisible. So on 2026-08-10 the gate rejected a lap, told it in the rejection text to record a round, and then could not see the round it recorded — leaving route_change as the only open door, which is the metronome the refill exists to stop. Fixed as instrument repair (RUNBOOK 3.9's exception) in gate-verdict.mjs roundTimestamps, with a regression in tests/run-tests.mjs that also asserts over the REAL register, because a unit test on an invented object is what passes while this is broken.

observed_not_guessed.elected_route: route_7_delivery_is_the_binding_term, elected 14:40Z. It supersedes route 5 because route 5 PASSED: the idle pool was asked for a deliverable and payload-01 conforms on every mechanically checkable term. Route 5's other refutation — a conforming payload that moves nothing at rungs 2 to 4 — has NOT happened either; that round is still in flight. A route is replaced here when its term stops binding, not only when it is proved wrong.

observed_not_guessed.lap_cost: Still 0 usable readings in state/laps.json. All three laps this session ended not usable (below_measurement_resolution, no_new_usage_reading). The per-lap cost the gate reserves with is a derived upper bound and the reservation is capped from 143% down to 9.10%.

known_gaps: No channel reports a non-null idle_eta_days. That is still the stated top goal and no lap this session moved it. What the three laps bought is a delivery route that might exist, a gate that can see its own inputs, and a rung-1 record that stopped reciting a withdrawn ceiling — none of which is revenue.

tests/run-tests.mjs loads no module that imports scripts/promise-conformance.mjs. A syntax error introduced there in lap 1 left the suite green and would have gone red only in pulse.yml at :00. Caught by running the script, not by the suite.

state/gumroad-file-replacement.json still recites 'the presigned upload endpoint the API's own refusal names is absent from this surface (12 path/method pairs)'. It is regenerated by its own probe, so it was NOT hand-edited — promise-conformance.mjs drops that sentence while the presign probe contradicts it. The probe itself should stop writing it; that is a real candidate and no lap has taken it.

The recognition half of the content probe cannot tell an encoding failure from an unsupported parameter. It only ever asserts recognition, and passage is a separate verdict, but a lap in a hurry can still read the two as one.
